text: Switch app theme from light to dark and ensure all UI elements adapt
Test high-contrast mode for visually impaired: all buttons and text should be readable
Change font size via profile settings; all buttons and fields should scale correctly
Select custom accent color in settings, verify display on all pages
Enable night mode on mobile device and test drag'n'drop and tooltips functionality
Change theme to system default — ensure app responds to system light/dark switching
Test hidden/disabled element functionality: states should be visible in each theme
Test validation error display on all themes (color, contrast, positioning)
Select large UI scale (120%): verify pop-up and overlay element adaptation
Enable dark mode — ensure images, icons and text do not invert incorrectly
Test last active theme restoration on browser reload
Try changing UI language within custom theme — verify no CSS conflicts
Perform multiple rapid theme changes: ensure app doesn't lag and switches all styles correctly
Take page screenshots for each theme, compare important block display (logo, nav)
Verify dark mode navbar receives required opacity value
Enable custom theme with unique font, verify browser support across all browsers
Test emoji icon display in different theme modes
Enable night mode in mobile PWA, verify splash and status bar correctness
Remove custom theme, ensure reset occurs without user data loss
Test multilingual UI display in different themes (colors, sizes, block overflow)
